prompt:
ClickHouse ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN is not parsed as a column change. It should parse into exp.Alter with an exp.AlterColumn action and be generated canonically as ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE, including with IF EXISTS; MODIFY COLUMN forms sqlglot does not support (for example REMOVE DEFAULT) should still fall back to a Command.

For example:

```python
from sqlglot import parse_one, transpile, exp

parse_one("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN c Int64", read="clickhouse").sql("clickhouse")
# currently: ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN c Int64
# expected:  ALTER TABLE t ALTER COLUMN c TYPE Int64

type(parse_one("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN c Int64", read="clickhouse").args["actions"][0]).__name__
# currently: KeyError: 'actions'
# expected:  AlterColumn

parse_one("ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN IF EXISTS c Int64", read="clickhouse").sql("clickhouse")
# currently: ALTER TABLE t MODIFY COLUMN IF EXISTS c Int64
# expected:  ALTER TABLE t ALTER COLUMN IF EXISTS c TYPE Int64
```

Other forms of the same constructs described above should work as well.
